# Native engine provenance

OrcaPad release-0.19.0, commit 20e698819e6b61f05408dee3f43b989b1a7ba8da.
OrcaSlicer v2.4.2, commit 8500fcdccaa10b5099ac20d252af3a7c560046f1.
C ABI 42. Device arm64 only; simulator reports unavailable rather than simulating a slice.

Complete engine source and build instructions:
https://github.com/iSteeb/OrcaPad/releases/tag/release-0.19.0
Asset OrcaPad-release-0.19.0-full-source.tar.gz.

Engine, bridge, profiles and this combined app are AGPL-3.0-only; preserve upstream
notices and Resources/Licenses. Before distributing this combined app, supply its
complete corresponding source (including modifications and engine source) with the build.

This is an independent app, not an official Bambu Lab or Snapmaker application.
